title: Volleyball: NU on brink of V-League crown after stunning FEU
summary: National University pulled off a hard-earned sweep of the erstwhile unbeaten Far Eastern University to move on the brink of the championship in the 2026 V-League Collegiate Challenge on Wednesday.
